nameAr: أحمد بن نصر بن زياد القرشي النيسابوري

taqrib.en: Reliable, a jurist, a hadith master and an ascetic.

verdicts.ar: كان من خيار عباد الله وأصلب أهل بلده في السنة
verdicts.en: Among the best of God's servants and the firmest of his townsmen in the Sunna.

bio: A Qur'an reciter, jurist and ascetic of Nishapur; a teacher of both al-Tirmidhi and al-Nasa'i. Al-Tirmidhi notes that “more than one” other teacher gave him this report as well.
